tps.bug: Loki split/shard queries are now interpolated with applyTemplateVariables before splitting and again on execution, so ad hoc filters are applied twice and already-substituted values are re-interpolated.
tps.evidenciaOpus: querySplitting.ts:299 now runs datasource.applyTemplateVariables on each target, and the split requests still go through runQuery -> super.query, which applies applyTemplateVariables again; runShardSplitQuery (shardQuerySplitting.ts:52) interpolates first and then delegates to runSplitQuery (the test now expects 5 calls for one target). Ad hoc filters get re-added (duplicated label filters after parsers) and interpolated values containing '$' are re-expanded.
tps.evidenciaAstra: public/app/plugins/datasource/loki/querySplitting.ts:299 adds interpolation before execution, while datasource.ts:352 delegates to DataSourceWithBackend.ts:185, which interpolates again; shardQuerySplitting.ts:52 adds another pass. template_srv.ts:299 rescans variable tokens on each call, and modifyQuery.ts:537 appends pipeline filters without deduplication, so substituted literal variable tokens can change query results.

tps.bug: runShardSplitQuery now filters empty/hidden targets before interpolation, so an expr that interpolates to an empty string is no longer dropped.
tps.evidenciaOpus: shardQuerySplitting.ts:49-52 now filters on the raw expr before applyTemplateVariables, whereas base interpolated first; only a target whose whole expr is a variable resolving to '' now survives as a blank query, an unusual misconfiguration case.
tps.evidenciaAstra: public/app/plugins/datasource/loki/shardQuerySplitting.ts:49–52 now filters before interpolation, allowing expressions that become empty into the group created at line 246. Alongside valid shardable targets, this can create an empty-expression-only group: querySplitting.ts:298 removes its target, then line 96 dereferences a nonexistent partition and fails.
